A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, figures, table, equations, and complete supplementary material are readable and can be matched despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, and ImageNet, including pruning comparisons and supplementary sensitivity analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results in Figures 4–10 and Table 1.

M1.justification: Both versions use the same teacher supervision, classification/distillation objectives, pruning-dependent KD weighting, and additional distillation losses in Section 4.4. The revised schematic does not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same classification tasks on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, and ImageNet. The supplementary experiments retain the same dataset and scenario coverage.

E2.justification: Figures 4–5 retain the same experiment-specific pruning comparators, and Table 1 retains all distillation methods and the no-KD baseline. The newly cited pruning work is not added to the evaluations.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, architectures, pruning fractions, accuracy metrics, training schedules, and KD settings are unchanged. The implementation overview moves to supplementary Section 6 without revising the reported settings.

E4.justification: Both retain KD-weight sensitivity in Figures 6 and 8, teacher-capacity analyses in Figures 7 and 9, temperature sensitivity in Figure 10, and qualitative examples in Figures 2–3.

E5.justification: Neither version supplies evaluation seed/run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The same averaging over 20 models for ImageNet EL2N pruning scores is documented in supplementary Section 6.1.

E6.justification: The matched result plots and all Table 1 values are unchanged; for example, at 10% retention, KD scores 46.27 and VID scores 49.46 in both versions. Shortened discussion does not remove the corresponding plotted findings.

T1.justification: Section 3.3 retains the same regression assumptions and Theorem 1. Supplementary Section 10 preserves Lemma 1, Theorem 2, and the complete SVD-based derivation, including its approximation when adding a sample.

C1.justification: The claims about KD benefits, random pruning, pruning-dependent weighting, estimation bias, and smaller teachers remain. Condensing the contribution list from five bullets to four does not change their scientific scope.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 removes the qualification that smaller teachers' effectiveness is bounded partly by their own accuracy, and trims the contrast with larger teachers' benefits at high retention. The central label-noise and capacity-gap interpretations remain.

D1.justification: Implementation recipes are retained, with the overview relocated to supplementary Section 6. However, v2 omits the explicit CIFAR dataset access URLs present in v1 references 20–21. Both versions still promise future code availability.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Yang et al., Dataset Pruning: Reducing Training Data by Examining Generalization Influence, and briefly describes its constrained discrete optimization approach. The other cited works and overall positioning are retained.

P1.justification: v2 condenses the contribution bullets, trims passages in Sections 4.1 and 4.3 and the conclusion, and relocates the implementation overview. Most prose and the overall section sequence remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The main paper changes from single-column to two-column layout, with extensive resizing and relocation of displays and a wider supplementary layout. Figure 1a drops the separate model-compression schematic, while Table 1 becomes a column-width display.

improvement.justification: The method, experimental support, and theoretical argument remain unchanged. Larger plots and an added related-work citation offer modest benefits, while the removed teacher-accuracy qualification and dataset links reduce some context and convenience. These limited tradeoffs leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
